default/30673.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: The Cruma Tower is one of the few remaining repositories of Giant technology. We have been searching it for the last couple of years, but the secrets are not easily revealed.

Q00183_RelicExploration/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Hello! What can I do for you?

Q00183_RelicExploration/30673-05.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Did Nikola tell you that he wanted to work together? What, you haven't left yet? Aren't you going to keep your promise?

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Well! Where is the place we're looking for? Did that coward tell you?

links.text: Tell her about the contract with Nikola.

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-04.html.text: Researcher Lorain: I think we searched the entire 1st floor after comparing my information to Nikola's map. The place we were in danger was somewhere on the 2nd floor. Nikola said that he was examining some broken devices in the front with help from the keeper, but he couldn't determine their exact…

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-06.html.text: Researcher Lorain: As I told you, climb up to the 2nd floor of the tower and pass the crossroads. You will see an intersection where 3 roads meet. Go to the right and you should be able to see the broken pieces of the machine. Hurry!

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-07.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Were you in any danger?

Q00185_NikolasCooperation/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Well! Where is the place? Did that coward tell you?

links.text: "He wanted to repair his relationship with you -- he told me that what happened was simply a misunderstanding. As a sign of good faith, he lent me this map to show you."

I think we must ask Nikola for help -- he knows a lot of people, one of whom may be able to repair this. I know I should probably visit him myself, but I'm still a litle worried about the…

Q00188_SealRemoval/30673-04.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Did you visit Nikola ? Please find a way to repair these broken metal pieces.

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: You sure took your time! Were you successful?

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30673-03.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Please visit Priest Shegfield in the Town of Dion and question him about the whereabouts of the Cruma.

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30673-04.html.text: Researcher Lorain: I see... Well, if the Cruma are extinct, then I suppose we don't need the section concerning it. Thank your for your help, though. Please go report all this to Kusto . I'm sure that he will reward you for your hard work. Farewell, and may the hammer of Maphr make clear your path!

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30673-05.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Many thanks for your trouble. I suppose there's nothing left for you to do here. Please go report all this to Kusto . Farewell, and may the hammer of Maphr make clear your path!

Q00190_LostDream/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Is that so? Well, I'll ask Kusto about the cost. At least we've finished one mission. Good job! I hope we can work together again. One last favor... On your way back, please tell Nikola that I'm not angry with him any more, and that I'm ready to work together again.

Q00190_LostDream/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Good job! One last favor... On your way back, please tell Nikola that I'm not angry with him any more, and that I'm ready to work together again. Farewell, and may the hammer of Maphr make clear your path!

Q00191_VainConclusion/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: You sure took your time! How did it go?

links.text: Show him the repaired metal plate.

He managed to escape, but if he doesn't get an Antidote quickly he will surely die. Fortunately, all of the materials we need for the Antidote can be found around here... W…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30183-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Hagger: I was one of the founding members of the coin collecting club. People made fun of me for collecting things, but I was simply collecting coins. However... For a number of reasons, I'm still at level 3... Take a look at my impressive coin list. If there's something you'd like…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30696-01.html.text: Magister Page: Ah, a rookie! I'm surprised you made it this far... Oh well, coin collecting is a great pastime. It's not too complicated... You can make some great trades in a place like this... Once you know what you're doing, you can really clean up! Here is a list of the coins I have. Take a loo…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30673-01.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Sometimes I question my decision to start collecting coins. Many people have made their families destitute with this collecting business. But once you get started it's hard to stop. I have heard that my personality changes when I trade coins. What do you wish to trade with? These…

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-01.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: By any chance are you headed to the Cruma Tower? I need some help with something. I believe I've discovered the secret source of energy used by the ancient Titans, but I must conduct several more experiments to confirm my findings.

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-03.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: I can't bring myself to sacrifice your life for the sake of my research. Come back when you're older. (This quest may only be undertaken by a character of level 37 or above.)

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-04.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: This relic could use a little more exposure to the catherok. It is not yet useful for my research. Please do it again.

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-07.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: Dammit! You've destroyed the relic! If you can't handle a simple task like this, how do you expect to ever be a great adventurer? You have one more chance. Don't screw it up!

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-08.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: You've done it! Did you feel that amazing sensation? Don't look at me like that... You know you love it!
when: state STARTED; has items 5879,5880; lacks items 5880

Q00183_RelicExploration/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Ah! You're the one I was promised could help me... But you're too late. I was surprised by a monster while searching the 2nd floor, and I ended up having a big fight with that arrogant Nikola over there. He's so frustrating! I know he has a great deal of insight into these matter…

links.text: "But you have to continue your work!"

Q00183_RelicExploration/30673-03.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Would you work with someone who abandoned you in the face of danger? You and I can work together, and I'm sure we'll make progress. Of course, it is going to be harder to find the area we need...

links.text: "Give me some time and I'll see if I can patch things up between you two."

Q00183_RelicExploration/30673-04.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Well, if you want to, I suppose that's up to you. I won't stop you, but I won't guarantee anything, either. And don't take too long! I want you to search for that area as soon as you get back.

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Hmm, I must admit that you did better than I expected. I am satisfied. As long as our work can continue... Now then, show me the map. I need to study it to see where we should search.

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-03.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Patience! I need a little more time to study this map.

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-05.html.text: Researcher Lorain: After you go up to the 2nd floor and pass the crossroads, you will see an intersection where 3 roads meet. Go to the right and you should be able to see the broken pieces of the machine. Be careful, though -- the alarm system in that area may be still functional. If you let the a…

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-08.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Well, I'm relieved that you're OK. May I see what you recovered from the ruins?

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-09.html.text: Researcher Lorain: To ensure that there are no oversights, we're issuing a certificate whenever we trade with anyone. Please keep this in a safe place -- if you lose it, you'll be in big trouble ! Now go get some rest. (If you lose the Certificate of Lorain, you will be moved back to the Seal Remov…

Q00184_ArtOfPersuasion/30673-10.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Good job! After I study this, I'll ask for your help. In the meantime, you'd best go get some rest.

Q00185_NikolasCooperation/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: What? Misunderstanding? What is that old man talking about? That's absurd... But he said he would help us, eh? It's certainly not like him to lend us his precious map. I'm still angry at him, but now I have to admit I'm curious enough about his motives to talk to him again... In …

Q00186_ContractExecution/30673-03.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: It seems that this metal plate is actually an ancient recording device used in a research lab in the Tower of Cruma. Please tell that to Nikola, and ask him to help us solve the password.

Q00187_NikolasHeart/30673-03.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: It seems that this metal plate is actually an ancient recording device used in a research lab in the Tower of Cruma. Please tell that to Nikola , and ask him to help us solve the password. Perhaps we can set aside our differences in the face of this amazing new discovery...

Q00188_SealRemoval/30673-03.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: Tell him these metal fragments are actually parts of an ancient recording device, and ask him if he knows how to restore it. If there's a way to do so, I trust you to see that it gets done.

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: You did it! Amazing.. . Hmm... experiments concerning the life force... To think that a Cruma may still exist! We must find it. I'm sure that Priest Shegfield, the Elven priest for the Town of Dion , knows more about this matter. I'm sorry to impose on you further, but I'm reluct…

As you see, we cannot do much research with such a small group. Moreover, we constantly have to fight off these monsters and poisonous insects... Ah! My colleague awakes! You must excuse me now.…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30673-02.html.text: Researcher Lorain: Ah, the Gold Knight! Do you want to use the boring old standard exchange rate or would you prefer an exciting game of chance?

His attack caused my body to start tingling all over, followed by complete paralysis! Luckily, my colleagues saved me from certain death! When I gathered my wits, I notic…

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-05.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: Keep up the good work.

Q00367_ElectrifyingRecharge/30673-06.htm.text: Researcher Lorain: What a bummer! I thought you were an adventurer!
